shared_elements: rows of repeated small marks or strokes
figures with raised or extended limbs
justification: Both surfaces show schematic figures and creatures accompanied by rows of repeated short strokes and a horizontal dividing line, but that is about the extent of the correspondence. A is dominated by manned boats with crew-stroke hulls, a large disc-headed staff object and sun/star rosettes, while B shows quadrupeds and beaked creatures stacked in registers with arcaded/lobed framing at the top — no distinctive motif or relationship is shared.
